dct_description_sm: This Voice of the People poll seeks the opinions of Canadians, on predominantly economic, political, and social issues.  The questions ask opinions of the state of the economy, predictions for 2005, and world progress. There are also questions on other topics of interest such as job safety, and industrial disputes. The respondents were also asked questions so that they could be grouped according to geographic and social variables.    Topics of interest include: economy; 2005; job safety; and industrial disputes.  Basic demographic variables are also included.
dct_title_s: Voice of the People, End of the Year Survey, 2004, [Canada]
